A Guide to ASUS Laptops at CES 2026: Which One Is Right for You?

Tech News·
Trends & Innovation·
AI PC·

Laptops·

This photo shows the AIways Incredible 2026 ASUS New Copilot+ PC Lineup: ASUS Zenbook DUO, ASUS Zenbook A16, ProArt GoPro Edition, ProArt PZ14, ASUS Vivobook S16.

At CES 2026, ASUS unveiled a lineup of next-generation Copilot+ PCs that blend powerful AI acceleration, premium craftsmanship, and ultralight portability. From the versatile ASUS Zenbook DUO to the creator-focused ProArt series, this year’s ASUS innovations prove one thing: the future of laptops is smarter, sleeker, and more flexible than ever.

Whether you’re a digital artist, business traveler, or hybrid professional, ASUS now offers a model that fits perfectly into your workflow. Here’s your complete guide to the standout ASUS CES 2026 laptops — and how to choose the right one for your needs.

  • ASUS Zenbook DUO: The Dual-Screen Visionary
  • ASUS Zenbook A16: The Premium AI Performer
  • ASUS Zenbook A14: The Ultra-Light AI Companion
  • ProArt GoPro Edition: The Creative Storyteller’s Powerhouse
  • ProArt PZ14: The Hybrid Creator Device
  • ASUS CES 2026 Laptop Comparison at a Glance
  • 2026 ASUS Laptops: The Future Is Intelligent
  • FAQ: ASUS CES 2026 Laptops

ASUS Zenbook DUO: The Dual-Screen Visionary

The new ASUS Zenbook DUO takes dual-screen design to the next level. Featuring a full Ceraluminum™ chassis and with two stunning 3K 144 Hz ASUS Lumina Pro OLED touchscreens reaching 1000-nits peak brightness that come standard with anti-reflective coating, it’s a productivity powerhouse designed for creators, multitaskers, professional or anyone who prefers extra screen space.

Powered by the latest Intel® Core Ultra Series 3 processor, with up to 50 TOPS NPU and 45W TDP, and up to 12Xe cores, delivering discrete graphics like performance this Copilot+ PC is made for next-gen AI workflows. Despite the unique two-screen form factor, it remains sleek and portable at just 1.65kg, with a 5% smaller footprint than its predecessor.

Perfect for:

  • Entrepreneurs, managers, freelancers, and other multitasking, productivity buffs.
  • Users who prefer seamless switching between Dual-screen, Desktop, or Sharing modes via ASUS ScreenXpert software.

ASUS Zenbook A16: The Premium AI Performer

The ASUS Zenbook A16 redefines what a thin and light laptop can achieve. Built entirely from Ceraluminum™ — an advanced ceramic-aluminum alloy — it combines elegance, strength, and exceptional portability at just 1.2 kg.

Under the hood, it runs the 18-core Snapdragon® X2 Elite Extreme processor with pro-level graphics and an 80 TOPS NPU, ensuring seamless AI acceleration and blazing-fast performance for effortless multitasking. Its 16-inch 3K OLED display (1100 nits*, 120Hz) and six-speaker Dolby Atmos system make it perfect for creators and entertainment lovers alike.

With a 70 Wh battery offering over 21+ hours of video playback, the ASUS Zenbook A16 is ideal for long-haul productivity.

Perfect for:

  • Professionals who require power within an elegant package and plenty of creative canvas for productivity and multitasking.
  • Uncompromising enjoyers of stunning visuals who accept nothing but the best visual experiences. 

ASUS Zenbook A14: The Ultra-Light AI Companion

Weighing under 1 kg, the new ASUS Zenbook A14 is perfect for on-the-go professionals. Crafted from Ceraluminum™ alloy like its larger sibling, it’s durable yet refined, making it a top lightweight laptop for travel and hybrid work.

Powered by the 18-core Snapdragon® X2 Elite processor with an 80 TOPS NPU, the ASUS Zenbook A14 handles AI-enhanced multitasking, productivity, and light creative work with ease. The 14-inch FHD OLED display and super-linear speakers deliver premium visuals and audio in a compact design.

A 70 Wh battery provides over 33 hours of playback, setting a new benchmark for multi-day productivity.

Perfect for:

  • Frequent travelers, students, and mobile professionals who want ultra-portability without sacrificing performance.
  • Hybrid workers requiring serious power for productivity without compromising on mobility and compact form factor.

ProArt GoPro Edition: The Creative Storyteller’s Powerhouse

The ProArt GoPro Edition is designed for creators who capture and edit life on the move. Developed in partnership with GoPro, this special edition merges GoPro-inspired rugged design, high performance, and a seamless GoPro workflow — complete with a matching sleeve and special packaging. It’s powered by the AMD Ryzen™ AI Max+ 395 processor with a 50 TOPS NPU, and it offers up to 128 GB unified memory. The 13.3-inch ASUS Lumina OLED display ensures cinematic color precision for photo or video editing. Exclusive GoPro Hotkey and GoPro Cloud integration with StoryCube for streamlined footage management. Combined with Copilot+ AI tools, the ProArt GoPro Edition is your portable AI studio for limitless creation.

Exclusive GoPro integration allows automatic syncing with GoPro Cloud and StoryCube for streamlined footage management. Combined with Copilot+ AI tools, the ProArt GoPro Edition becomes an all-in-one creative hub.

Perfect for:

  • Adventure filmmakers, travel vloggers, and on-the-go video editors looking for a durable laptop for editing anywhere.

ProArt PZ14: The Hybrid Creator Device

Designed for flexibility, the ProArt PZ14 bridges the gap between tablet and laptop — ideal for everyday creatives. Built from aerospace-grade aluminum and weighing just 0.79 kg, it’s incredibly portable yet powerful.

The Snapdragon® X2 Elite 18-core processor with 80 TOPS NPU drives real-time AI workflows, while the 14-inch ASUS Lumina Pro OLED (3K, up to 1000 nits, 144 Hz) ensures professional-grade visuals. Its ASUS Pen 3.0 with haptic feedback and a Bluetooth keyboard turn it into a versatile canvas for sketching, editing, or planning anywhere.

Tested to U.S. MIL-STD 810H standards and boasting an IP52 rating, and featuring a 75 Wh battery, dual USB4 ports and an SD card reader, it’s the ultimate creator laptop for the hybrid era.

Perfect for:

  • Digital artists, illustrators, and students who value pen precision and portability.
  • Creators who need a tablet laptop hybrid for both art and productivity.

From the ultralight ASUS Zenbook lineup to creator-focused ProArt devices, the CES 2026 lineup of ASUS laptops showcases how AI PCs are transforming everyday workflows. Whether you need the multitasking power of ASUS Zenbook DUO, the cinematic creativity of the ASUS Zenbook A16, or the portable freedom of ProArt PZ14, there’s an ASUS Copilot+ PC designed to match your craft, lifestyle, and ambition.

FAQ: ASUS CES 2026 Laptops

Q1. What is a Copilot+ PC?

A Copilot+ PC is a new class of AI-powered laptop equipped with NPUs (Neural Processing Units) capable of running on-device AI tasks, offering faster, more secure, and energy-efficient performance.

Q2. Which ASUS CES 2026 laptop is best for creators?
